props.text: Trần Hải Đăng & Nguyễn Khả Ái

The most beautiful love, 
there is no end of time,there is no land, 
just want to accompany you for life, 
that's all

Love rises with the wind,
yet lingers when the wind fades.
Dusk belongs to sunset,
and I belong to you.

Grateful for time’s company,
the rest of my days belong to you.

I once thought life
was a journey to mountains and seas alone.
Until you came into my world, I finally understand:
the most beautiful scenery lies not in distant lands,
but in having you right by my side.

Love is not a matter of
counting the days
It’s making the days count.
